description: This file defines a class for handling logarithmic axes in a graphing library, including methods for calculating label intervals, preprocessing values for logarithmic scale, and determining label positions and axis intersections.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Logarithmic
classes.description: Class for creating and managing a logarithmic axis in a graph, including label calculation and value preprocessing.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Logarithmic
methods.description: Constructor for the logarithmic axis class, sets default minimum value and label display options.

methods.name: _calcLabelInterval
methods.description: Calculates the interval between labels on the logarithmic axis, adjusting axis value span accordingly.

methods.name: _value
methods.description: Preprocesses a value for logarithmic scaling by applying log10 and adjusting by minimum.

methods.name: _getNextLabel
methods.description: Determines the next label position on the logarithmic axis based on current label and level.

methods.name: _intersectPoint
methods.description: Calculates the pixel position where the axis intersects a given value, with safeguards for non-positive values.
